visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young girl with black hair tied in two pigtails and wearing a red and black striped shirt is sitting on a light wooden floor. An adult's hand enters the frame from the right, holding a small dark grape and feeding it to her. She opens her mouth wide and takes it. (2) The girl is chewing the grape while looking towards the camera with a serious yet curious expression. The background consists of light wood cabinets and a white kitchen trash bin. (3) The scene cuts to the girl wearing a pink checkered dress, sitting in the same location. She looks up and smiles brightly at someone off-camera. A blue and red water bottle sits on the floor beside her. (4) Another cut back to the girl in the striped shirt. She continues to chew and watch the caregiver intently. She occasionally moves her mouth as if trying to pronounce words while eating. (5) The video ends with a pink background graphic showing a cartoon illustration of the girl and text appearing in the center.
